slides.title: The 3 C's of Prompting
content: Weak prompt = Weak answer
Great prompt = Great answer
Three key ingredients: Clarity, Context, Constraints
slides.narration:
Have you ever received a weak answer from an AI?
This often happens due to a weak prompt.
A great prompt gives a great answer.
The best prompts use three key ingredients.
These are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic illustrating a 'weak prompt' leading to a 'weak answer' and a 'good prompt' leading to a 'good answer,' with icons for Clarity, Context, and Constraints.

slides.title: 1. Clarity: Be Specific!
content: AI doesn't know what you're thinking
Vague prompts lead to generic answers
Be specific to get helpful answers
slides.narration:
Let's start with the first C — Clarity.
The AI cannot read your mind.
Vague prompts give generic, unhelpful answers.
You must be specific in your instructions.
slides.image_prompt: Person with a thought bubble (complex idea) vs. AI with a question mark.

slides.title: Clarity: Weak Prompt Example
content: Weak Prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
slides.narration:
Let's look at a weak prompt example.
Type 'Write about electric cars' into an AI tool.
The AI will give a general overview.
It will not be specific or very useful.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of an AI chat interface showing the weak prompt 'Write about electric cars' and a generic response.

slides.title: Clarity: Good Prompt Example
content: Good Prompt: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration:
Now, let's make it clear.
Here is a good prompt example.
It asks to 'Write a short blog post'.
It specifies 'top 3 benefits of owning an electric car'.
And it is for 'someone living in a city'.
This tells the AI exactly what to do.
See the difference in specificity?
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of an AI chat interface showing the good prompt and a more focused response. Side-by-side comparison with the weak prompt output from the previous slide.

slides.title: 2. Context: Give it Background!
content: Tell AI why you're asking
Define the audience
Helps AI adopt the right perspective
slides.narration:
Next, let's add the second C — Context.
Context gives the AI background information.
It tells the AI why you are asking.
It also defines the audience.
This helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of AI receiving background information, perhaps a person explaining a scenario to a robot.

slides.title: Context: Good Prompt
content: Good Prompt: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration:
We start with our good prompt from before.
It is clear about the task.
But it lacks specific background.

slides.title: Context: Better Prompt Example
content: Better Prompt (with Context): 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration:
Let's add context to this prompt.
We'll specify the platform and its focus.
For example, 'Write a short blog post'.
It is 'for a lifestyle blog'.
This blog 'focuses on sustainable living'.
This guides the AI's tone and content.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the 'Better Prompt' with the added context highlighted.

slides.title: 3. Constraints: Set the Rules!
content: Boundaries that shape output
Specify length, format, style
Tell AI what you need
slides.narration:
Now, let's look at the third C — Constraints.
Constraints are rules for the AI.
They set boundaries for the output.
Tell the AI about length, format, and style.
This shapes the answer precisely.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic with rules or boundaries, perhaps a ruler or a 'STOP' sign icon.

slides.title: Constraints: Better Prompt
content: Better Prompt: 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration:
Let's use our better prompt again.
It has clarity and context.
Now, we need to add specific rules.

slides.title: Constraints: Excellent Prompt Example
content: Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): 'Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments.'
slides.narration:
Here is an excellent prompt with constraints.
We specify 'under 400 words'.
We add 'friendly and enthusiastic tone'.
And 'end with a question to encourage comments'.
These constraints make the output very specific.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the 'Excellent Prompt' with constraints highlighted. Side-by-side comparison of the 'Better' vs 'Excellent' prompt outputs.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be
Super-powerful trick
Helps AI adopt a specific role
slides.narration:
Here is a bonus tip for you.
You can tell the AI to act as a persona.
This is a super-powerful trick.
It makes the AI adopt a specific role.
slides.image_prompt: Icon of a person wearing different hats (roles).

slides.title: Persona Example
content: Prompt: 'Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food.'
slides.narration:
For example, 'Act as an expert travel agent.'
Then, 'Create a 5-day itinerary for Rome.'
Specify 'solo traveler who loves history and food.'
The AI will respond like a travel agent.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of an AI chat interface showing the persona prompt and a travel itinerary response.

slides.title: Summary
content: Weak prompts give weak answers.
Good prompts have Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Clarity means being specific.
Context gives background and audience.
Constraints set rules for length, format, and style.
Using a Persona enhances AI's role.
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, we learned that weak prompts give weak answers.
Good prompts include Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Clarity means being specific in your instructions.
Context provides background and defines the audience.
Constraints set rules for the AI's output.
Remember to use a Persona for even better results.
slides.image_prompt: Icons for C, C, C, and a person's head for persona, all connected to a 'good prompt' icon.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Choose a topic you are interested in.
Write a weak prompt for it.
Rewrite the prompt using Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Add a Persona to your improved prompt.
Compare the AI's responses for all three prompts.
slides.narration:
Here is an assignment for you.
Choose any topic you like.
First, write a weak prompt for it.
Next, rewrite it using Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Then, add a Persona to your improved prompt.
Finally, compare the AI's responses for all three.
